content.text: No Customer-side non-compete or field-of-use restriction exists; the document affirmatively disclaims one.

input.quote: 12.3 Nothing restricts Customer from developing, acquiring, licensing, selling, or using any product or service, engaging any supplier, hiring any person who responds to general recruitment, or conducting business in any field or territory. Vendor acknowledges that Customer has made no exclusivity, non-compete, most-favoured-customer, minimum-volume, or no-hire commitment.
input.rationale: The Agreement contains no non-compete, exclusivity, or field-of-use restriction binding Customer. Section 12.3 expressly confirms Customer is free to develop, acquire, license, sell, or use any product or service, engage any supplier, and conduct business in any field or territory, and that no exclusivity or non-compete commitment has been made. Section 2.1 confirms no minimum quantity or purchase commitment. The only competition-related restraint (§ 12.4) and the assignment restraint (§ 24, p0100) bind Vendor, which the rule permits. Licence restrictions in § 13.4 are limited to reverse engineering, interference, security bypass, and unlawful use — not competing-product or build restrictions. Preferred position met; no redline required.
